_note: Each folder's 'intent' is the hidden ground truth used to write labels. It is NEVER passed to the model; the model only sees folder names (until we explicitly experiment with richer folder representations).

users.persona: Few broad, clearly named folders (4). Easy case for title-based ranking, with one mild ambiguity: interview advice could go to Career or Data Science.

folders.name: Sports
folders.intent: Any sport: technique tips, drills, pro gameplay, highlights.

folders.intent: ML and data science concepts, projects, questions.

folders.name: Career
folders.intent: Job and interview advice, including data science interviews.

folders.name: Funny
folders.intent: Anything humorous: skits, stand-up, funny moments.

users.persona: Many fine-grained folders (7) with distinctions that depend on the user's habits: technique vs highlights, comedy vs things to share with a friend.
